body.content:
All,

  

During our recent construction planning discussions, we unveiled an issue with
the existing contracted scope of work. It is regarding the flooring; the
construction plans call out for a polished concrete finish. The existing
flooring areas (approximately 5,300 SF of LVT and rubber flooring) were noted
in our proposal as existing to remain and were therefore not included in the
construction pricing.

  

This is something that should have flagged earlier during the planning phase.
I take full responsibility for that.

  

With that said we want to give options to achieve the polished concrete floor.
Here's what we'd need to do: the existing flooring would need to be fully
demoed, the slab ground, sealed, and concrete polished.

  

We anticipate this additional scope to be approximately $25,000, subject to
final verification once we demo the existing floor.

  

Importantly, no billing has occurred for this work to date. it was simply
outside the agreed scope as written.

  

Our goal here is alignment and transparency. If everyone is comfortable
proceeding, we can issue this as an added scope item and integrate it cleanly
into the project plan without impacting any of the project scheduling or
momentum.

  

Happy to walk through this together on a quick call if helpful. Please let me
know how you’d like to proceed.

  

Troy Fink

Client Relations

Carney Contracting Services, Inc.

405 Estates Ct.

Newtown, PA 18940

C: 215-906-3474
